result.title: See the Future, Classify the Present: Stochastic Latent World Modeling for Hyperspectral Images
result.summary: Hyperspectral image classification (HSIC) relies on static spatial-spectral representations learned from labeled samples, limiting its ability to model structured dependencies in the latent representation space. To address this limitation, this work proposes Stochastic Latent World Modeling (LWM), a trajectory-based representation-learning framework that enriches classification through stochastic latent-state prediction. Given a hyperspectral patch, LWM tokenizes and encodes spectral and spatial information separately using dedicated transformer branches, then fuses their outputs into a unified representation. This representation is further organized into an environment state that captures center, neighborhood, spectral, and global contextual information. A stochastic latent transition module then predicts multiple future latent states through Gaussian parameterization and reparameterization, with recurrent refinement used to model dependencies across successive states. The resulting latent trajectory is adaptively aggregated by a rollout planner to construct a planned representation, which is integrated with the base representation for final classification. By extending static spatial-spectral encoding with stochastic multi-step latent-state modeling, LWM enables the classifier to exploit structured dependencies in the representation space and provides richer features for HSIC. Across five benchmark datasets, LWM achieves overall accuracies ranging from 89.21% to 99.52%, demonstrating consistent classification performance under limited-label settings.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向高光谱图像分类，提出 Stochastic Latent World Modeling：将空间与光谱分别编码融合为环境状态后，用高斯参数化的随机 latent 转移模块预测多步未来 latent 状态并以循环方式细化，再由 rollout planner 自适应聚合成计划表示，与基础表示融合后分类。
AI.relevance_reason: 其随机 latent 转移、逐步递归细化与 latent 轨迹聚合机制，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的生成与更新、任务相关 latent 的筛选与动态计算提供可核查的方法线索；但任务是遥感分类而非多模态推理，需核查该 latent 轨迹是否具备可迁移的推理语义。
